summary: The note describes Bobcat Company, an American-based manufacturer of farm and construction equipment that is part of South Korea's Doosan Group. It covers the company's headquarters history in North Dakota and Europe, its ownership history from Ingersoll Rand to Doosan Infracore, and its product line sold under the Bobcat brand.
one_line: Bobcat Company is a farm and construction equipment maker owned by South Korea's Doosan Group, with US and European headquarters.
key_facts: Bobcat Company is an American-based manufacturer of farm and construction equipment.
Bobcat Company is part of Doosan Group of South Korea.
Bobcat's American headquarters is in West Fargo, North Dakota, USA.
Bobcat's American headquarters was formerly in Gwinner, North Dakota.
Bobcat's European headquarters moved in 2017 from Waterloo, Belgium to Dobris (near Prague) in the Czech Republic.
Bobcat operates one of its European manufacturing plants in Dobris, Czech Republic.
Bobcat Company was a subsidiary of the Ingersoll Rand Company from 1995 until July 2007.
In July 2007, Bobcat Company was sold for US$4.9 billion to Doosan Infracore.
Bobcat sells skid steer loaders, compact excavators, compact utility vehicles, and compact tractors.
Bobcat sells other small hydraulic equipment under the Bobcat brand name.
Bobcat Company is one of the few major manufacturing companies operating in North Dakota.
